searchText: <@!425279588009246720> <https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/3132> is a disscussion issue for <https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3135> which is stagnant. You re-opened it as a discussions-to EIP. I am of the opinion that we should close discussions-to issues when they are for stagnant and withdrawn EIPs. Do you hold a different view on this? Also, why did you re-open this? <https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3696> Looks like you did this in a few places, which implies it is either intentional or you just re-opened a bunch of issues in some kind of automated way and they are all on accident. I took this as an indication from the author to keep it alive: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3696#issuecomment-941089258 It is something which should be merged anyway. I think all issues which are discussion URLs should be kept open. We can have another bot step which closes them if the EIP in question is withdrawn/archived, but not sure about stagnant. I guess all this goes back to the fact that I am not unsure about stagnant stage in general, I still think it should be just "withdrawn" with the "withdrawal-reason: inactivity" and allow withdrawn EIPs to be resurrected. <@!301186049323958275> looks like someone vandalized EIP-4444 and snuck in this clearly unprofessional section: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4444#confusion-with-other-proposals please fix https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/4450 this is really unprofessional this is what 3+ hour long party chats result in haha, you are not wrong Withdrawn should mean that the author withdrew it, not a bot. Otherwise it's misleading. E.g. EIP615 recently went Stagnant. I don't intend to withdraw it until other EIPs have done the job it set out to do, and I don't want people to think that I have done so.
